events.title: Paradise Lost: An Industrial Apocalypse
events.description:
Apocalypse Rave Culture invites the defiant to find blessed beauty in even the bleakest bid good night. Kiss farewell your lover as this world decays in dulcet tones of rust and concrete, but rejoice—for reunion is there, on the other side. Let Eve be your Charon, madeofants your ferry.

Come. Cross boldly the river Acheron and dance in the waters of Lethe, forgetful of all Stygian hates...this is the rest of rebellion. John Martin painted Pandemonium with oil—Detroit's best goth selectors spin the mortar of music. Let this fruitful flow of siren song soak you through with towering thunder, subverting the intent of the powers of this world, and with us all declaim:

Better to rain in hell.

As we tear heaven asunder.

events.title: VØRA: Saytek*LIVE with minimal detroit
events.description:
VØRA × Minimal Detroit present Saytek’s Detroit debut.

For more than two decades, Saytek has done something few in techno attempt: he doesn’t DJ. Every set is built live and improvised on hardware in real time. He came out of London’s squat and illegal party scene in the early 2000s and was performing machine-driven live sets long before “live techno” was a festival staple.

Detroit-rooted and warehouse-driven, high-energy and deeply hypnotic, rolling machine funk shaped by 90s techno from Detroit, Europe and the UK. Over 500 tracks, most recorded live, have landed on labels including Soma, Fabric, TRAX, R&S, Bedrock, KMS and Carl Cox’s Awesome Soundwave. Cox himself has called him a genius at playing live. He has been ranked in the top 10 of FAZEmag’s Live Act poll for three years running and has played Tresor, Fabric, Awakenings and Space Ibiza along the way.

Now the machines come to the city that inspired them. Live techno on the hardware, wax-only sets on the support, one night at SOS Detroit.

events.title: BMR: HONEYMOON HALLOWEEN
events.description:
YOU are getting verryyyy sleepyyy…BUT ITS TIME TO WAKE IT UP!

Honeymoon is back for a special HALLOWEEN EDITION at @templebardetroit, and we’re helming the booth ourselves with @ameera.img and @saylemceleste! 

To refresh your memory, Honeymoon is a quarterly residency where profits are always donated to mutual aid funds and grassroots organizations. Mutual aid is a core tenet of our work, and we are happy to host a program that allows us to work with musicians to reach that goal. 50% of our radio revenue goes to mutual aid commitments like Honeymoon because we believe that our joint survival is really that worth it. This month, we’re turning that care to ourselves to help secure the last of our gear for the station.

We’ll have some TRICKS and TREATS(!), and a little merch table too. Come check us out for an early crawl from 9pm to 2am, $5 all night!

We thank you, we love you, and we hope to see you there!
